wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-006 wires the two deterministic RNG streams and the demo ticcmd read/write path via one src/vanilla facade (wireRngAndDemoStreams.ts) re-exporting the read-only core/rng (RNG_TABLE frozen 256-entry rndtable, DoomRandom with independent prndindex/rndindex) and the demo/demoFile (DEMO_VERSION_19 109, DEMO_HEADER_SIZE 13, DEMO_TIC_SIZE 4, DEMO_END_MARKER 0x80, DEMO_MAX_PLAYERS 4, DEMO_TIC_RATE 35, parseDemoLump), demo/demoRecord (DemoRecorder), and demo/demoPlayback (DemoPlayback) modules. VANILLA_RNG_DEMO_INVARIANTS pins five rules: 256-entry frozen rndtable; DoomRandom deterministic without seed; P_Random / M_Random independent (no cross-stream drift); vanilla demo header/version/ticcmd/terminator; record and playback share the 4-byte tic stream. The focused test exercises real DoomRandom determinism + P/M-stream independence (calling mRandom does not perturb the pRandom sequence), the demo constants, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. Shared DEMO_* surfaced from demoFile only; demoParse/compare-demo-N not re-exported (would duplicate). No const enums. This step became eligible only after the 442975e cycle fix removed the spurious 12-006 back-edge.
